concepts.name: Cross-view consistency
concepts.description: Alignment among related elements, names, responsibilities, and relationships across architecture views.

concepts.name: View correspondence
concepts.description: A relationship that maps elements or concepts in one view to elements or concepts in another view.

concepts.name: Consistency check
concepts.description: A review activity that searches for contradictions or missing links across architecture artifacts.

concepts.name: Intentional inconsistency
concepts.description: A documented mismatch kept temporarily or deliberately because it reflects migration, variation, or an unresolved decision.

concepts.name: Architecture traceability
concepts.description: The ability to follow relationships from concerns and decisions to views, implementation, and evidence.

concepts.name: Trace link
concepts.description: An explicit connection between two architecture artifacts or between architecture and implementation evidence.

concepts.name: Verification evidence
concepts.description: A test, review, metric, prototype, or analysis result used to support an architectural claim.

concepts.name: Traceability burden
concepts.description: The maintenance cost created by recording and updating too many trace links.

concepts.name: Architecture review
concepts.description: A structured examination of architecture artifacts, decisions, risks, and quality support.

concepts.name: Documentation completeness
concepts.description: The degree to which documentation contains the information stakeholders need for its intended purpose.

concepts.name: Review criterion
concepts.description: A question or standard used to judge architecture quality, documentation quality, or decision adequacy.

concepts.name: Architecture defect
concepts.description: A flaw, omission, inconsistency, or risk in the architecture or its description.
